subject: angol
title: Changing groups at a language school
instructionsHu: Egy angliai nyári nyelviskolában tanulsz, de a csoportod túl könnyű neked. Menj be az irodába, magyarázd el a problémát, és intézd el a csoportváltást. Minden pontot teljesíts.

situation.context: You are attending a three-week summer English course in Brighton. After the first two days, you feel that your group is too easy for you: the lessons are boring and you already know most of the grammar. You go to the school office to talk to the course coordinator.
situation.candidateRole: You are a student on the summer course.
situation.examinerRole: The examiner is the course coordinator at the school office.
goals: Explain why you are not happy with your group.
Ask if you can move to a higher-level group.
Ask about the timetable of the new group.
Find out about the afternoon activities and choose one.
situation.examinerOpening: Hello, come in. How can I help you?

followUpQuestions: I see. Can you give me an example of what you're doing in class?
There's a place in the upper-intermediate group, but their lessons start at half past eight. Is that OK for you?
Is there anything else you'd like to know?

usefulPhrases.en: I'm in group B at the moment.
The lessons are too easy for me.
We're revising things I already know.
usefulPhrases.hu: Olyan dolgokat ismétlünk, amiket már tudok.

usefulPhrases.en: Would it be possible to change groups?
What time do the lessons start?
I'd like to sign up for ...
What activities are there in the afternoon?

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Hello, come in. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Hello. I'm Réka Tóth from group three. To be honest, I'm not very happy with my group, because the lessons are too easy for me.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: I see. Can you give me an example of what you're doing in class?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Well, yesterday we practised the present simple the whole morning, and I learnt that years ago. I've been learning English for nine years, so I'm a bit bored. Would it be possible to move to a higher-level group?

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: There's a place in the upper-intermediate group, but their lessons start at half past eight. Is that OK for you?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Yes, that's no problem. When do the lessons finish? And which room are they in?

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: They finish at half past twelve, with a break at ten. They're in room twelve on the first floor. You can start tomorrow.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Perfect, thank you. One more thing: what activities are there in the afternoons?

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: We've got beach volleyball, a cooking club and a photography walk around the town.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: The photography walk sounds great, because I love taking photos. Can I sign up for it here?

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Of course, I'll put your name down. Is there anything else you'd like to know?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: No, that's all. Thank you very much for your help!

notes: Kommunikációs cél: a vizsgázó sorban teljesíti a négy szempontot – elmondja és példával alátámasztja, miért elégedetlen, udvariasan kéri a csoportváltást, rákérdez az új csoport órarendjére, végül megtudja, milyen délutáni programok vannak, és indoklással választ egyet.
Szókincs: a helyzethez illő udvarias fordulatokat használ (To be honest, …; Would it be possible to …?; One more thing; Can I sign up for it?).

Nyelvhelyesség: a kérdések szórendje helyes (When do the lessons finish? Which room are they in?), a befejezett folyamatos jelen a „for” szóval (I've been learning English for nine years) és a múlt idő (practised, learnt) is hibátlan.
Érdemes megtanulni: „I'm not very happy with my group”, „Would it be possible to move to a higher-level group?”, „One more thing: …”, „Can I sign up for it here?”.
